name: ip-api
label: ip-api
description: ip-api official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: lookup, batch. Docs: https://ip-api.com/docs/api:json. Free HTTP endpoint is non-commercial. Commercial requires SSL + key (pro.ip-api.com). IP can be PII. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One ip-api request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"lookup"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: lookup | batch. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'lookup'.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `fields` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: ip
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `ip` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: ips
schema.description: Required for batch: JSON array sent as the whole POST /batch body, up to 100 entries (more returns HTTP 422). Each entry is an IP string or an object {query, fields?, lang?} that overrides the query-string fields for that IP. Example: ["208.80.152.201", {"query":"8.8.8.8","fields":"country,city"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: lookup, batch.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 15. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
